newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil-Chevron in cooperation pact in Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: Statoil-Chevron in cooperation pact in Venezuela.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday it had sealed a collaboration deal with U.S. oil company Chevron for Venezuela's third licensing bidding round for marginal fields.

Statoil said it was among the top 30 companies after a pre-qualification process. The state-owned Norwegian oil company said it had been accorded A status, meaning that it was financially qualified and could be awarded an operatorship without restrictions.

"The group is currently preparing for the round, planned for May 26, and its placement in the top category has great significance when drawing up strategy with the U.S. major," the company's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Venezuela has pre-qualified 259 companies, including 129 domestic firms. Each of the 20 properties on offer will be awarded to the highest cash bidder, Statoil said.
The fields are to be reactivated for increased production with the aid of new technology. Five have been reserved for national operatorship.
Statoil said overall output from the holdings was expected to total around 300,000 barrels per day in 10 years' time.
